Comparison of number of genes in regionally elevated expression in forebrain of human, pig and mouse.
```{r}
total_elevated_human <- sum(180,83,57,110)
print(paste("Number of genes in regionally elevated expression in forebrain of humans is:" , total_elevated_human))
```
```{r}
total_elevated_pig <- sum(109,157,31,45)
print(paste("Number of genes in regionally elevated expression in forebrain of pigs is:" , total_elevated_pig))
```
```{r}
total_elevated_mouse <- sum(55,185,60,98)
print(paste("Number of genes in regionally elevated expression in forebrain of mice is:" , total_elevated_mouse))
```
Humans have the highest number of genes at 430
